scope: Conversation-aware Nova fallback and stronger model instructions in Samuel Studio frontend. No shared assistant backend, model deployment, transcript destination or credentials changed.

Relative dates, long answers and requests for location suggestions advance intake
Events get event acknowledgement; web projects get development-site handoff

Book jacket is not mistaken for an instruction to book
